body:
This was copied from a notebook I kept with me while rolling.  Also, this was my first time trying MDMA.  I must say, however, that it was a truly amazing drug!
Gender: Male
Age: 19
Weight: 206 lb
Drug Experience: cannabis, cocaine, adderal, ritilin, oxycodone, hydrocodone, oxymorphone, suboxone, codeine, LSA, DXM, diphenhydramine, nitrous oxide, xanax, klonopin, valium, tobacco, alcohol, darvocet, ambien
10:00 AM: Injested 1 white butterfly pill believed to be MDMA. Weighted 0.3 g overall on the scale. I have a semi-empty stomach. I'm definitely anxious, as would be expected. Time will tell the nature of this experience.
10:41: Noticing subtle changes in perception enough to consider it off baseline. Checked my bp: 155/96 P 99. While effects could be placebo considering anxiousness awaiting my roll, I think I may be beginning to experience the drug.
11:02: Effects still rather subtle, yet noticeable. I feel the anxiousness going away. BP: 157/86 P 99. I'm home alone but while smoking a cig I was singing the whole time, coming up w/ a few nice tunes. Feeling a bit jittery also, which would be a common effect of a stimulant cut. I've got a bowl ready for 11:30 of some fuckin kill.
11:46: Definitely rolling now! After chatting with whoever was on facebook for 20 minutes or so, I just had an extremely long and deep discussion with my father about a little of everything, including things I'd normally avoid telling him. As expected I feel very empathetic and calm. I feel somewhat stimulated also, yet without the rush expected from most other stimulants; just awake, though I just got off work at 7 and have yet to even take a nap. No haze over my mind at all like I was expected. I feel as clearheaded as normal, though I can tell MUCH more talkative and giddy. Definitely jittery and clenching my jaw a lot (almost gum time). BP: 199/118 P 100! Hope that don't get much higher! Time to smoke a bowl to some music!
12:09 PM: That just fucking did it. I brought my iPod though only ended up taking 3 hits of the bowl, saving the rest for the test of the roll. Smoking the cig after that to some Nickelback and Bonjovi was possibly the best feeling I've ever had! The only thing missing was somebody with me, which I expected to be a problem, though I only had 1 pill and wanted to test this guy's product before letting my friends know about it. BP: 191/118 P 117
12:58: Definitely still feeling great, but I think I'm past the peak. The roll took forever to kick in, but once it did the come-up was extremely quick. The peak lasted around 45 min. I've jus been sittin around chattin with people on facebook.
1:25: Definitely coming down. Still don't feel baseline, but it's nothing compared to the peak.
1:46: Feel good still, but I think it's about done. Gonna smoke the rest of that bowl and see.
1:55: That didn't boost it except a little, but I am pretty stoned. Time for a nap.
I woke up around 6 definitely off the drug. I did notice that it had an extremely smooth comedown, as opposed to most harder drugs I've done. I must say though this was one of the best, if not THE best, high I've ever had.
